verdict.rationale: Sill is a remote-display and control app that streams Mac windows to an iPhone or iPad. A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for remote-access tools, so the axis applies. None of the evidence mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. Everything documented concerns streaming, touch, keyboard and trackpad input, pairing, and connectivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
